primary_goal: MobileFace verification >70% on the unchanged 9913-image/10640-pair cohort with original512 validation-only calibration.
recognition_fusion: Separate diagnostic: fixed equal average of ArcFace and MobileFace pair scores standardized using negative validation pairs; threshold fit only on validation. Never claim fusion changes reconstructed pixels.
secondary_calibration: Expanded held-out-training-identity calibration is a separately labeled pipeline; report the original512 result alongside it.
repeated_test_bias: These evaluation cohorts have already been inspected in earlier work; not a new untouched benchmark.

training_plan.selection: Max original512 ArcFace validation AUC, retaining only epochs with mean paired FFHQ validation LPIPS<=base+0.005, each PSNR>=base-0.15dB and SSIM>=base-0.003. Baseline retained if no eligible AUC improvement.
